individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked area/bar chart summarising median promoter-state frequencies across continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins (analogous to a trend/line plot); overlaying thousands of individual promoter values would be impractical and is exempt.

Single-molecule stack is itself a heatmap-like display where every row already represents one individual DNA molecule (raw data), so it is exempt from requiring an additional overlay of individual points.
